contract: Offline multilingual text-to-speech workspace for organizing scripts by project and replaying Hindi with a bundled neural voice or other languages with installed system voices. Primary hierarchy: projects, conversations, script metadata, and a flat Voice Studio containing one transport toggle plus a seekable, segment-selectable waveform. Visual direction: crisp graphite, coral, and sand with restrained corner radii and Tailwind utility styling.

accessibility.evidence: Browser accessibility inspection found named form controls, headings, navigation regions, visible focus styles, a skip link, status announcements, and 42px primary touch targets. The settings dialog exposes seven labeled sliders with English and Hindi descriptions, including initial pause. Reduced-motion rules are present.

responsive.evidence: The 1440px layout retains a fixed project rail and wide editor; the 500px layout stacks navigation, metadata, controls, and the audio player without horizontal overflow.

loading.reason: All workspace data and installed voice discovery are local and render synchronously without a blocking loading state.

empty.evidence: Created a local project with zero conversations; the rendered state showed a Create your first conversation heading, explanation, and Add conversation action.

error.evidence: Unsupported speech and playback error paths provide specific browser or alternate-voice recovery text while preserving locally saved content.

partial.evidence: Hindi retains its bundled neural voice without a system voice. For other languages, the interface explains how to install a missing voice while preserving saved content.

success.evidence: Kokoro-82M produced a local English WAV and rendered the WaveSurfer waveform, explicit seek bar, download link, and Play/Stop toggle. Hindi Kokoro uses a bundled Hindi voice and local espeak-ng phonemization; Priyamvada remains available as a fallback.

permission.reason: Browser speech synthesis and localStorage require no browser permission prompt.

renderedEvidence.observation: The graphite Voice Studio groups the single transport and flat coral waveform without nested cards; project navigation, Hindi metadata, and controls remain legible without overlap.
The graphite, coral, and sand hierarchy remains clear as the mobile page stacks into one readable flow; the waveform, Hindi text, and controls fit without horizontal overflow.
The sharper settings modal presents seven grouped tuning controls, including configurable initial pause, bilingual guidance, current values, reset, close, and done actions without obscuring labels.
